name: Nindo: Always Finish What I Start

system.description: This Nindo is one of conviction. Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 hit points, you gain 2 Drive, even if you gained Drive already this turn and can move up to half your speed towards another hostile creature. If you end this movement with that creature within your weapons range, you can make one weapon attack targeting them, dealing 2d6 bonus damage on a hit.
